title: Crash between blob publication and the envelope commit leaves only unreferenced immutable bytes

input.crashPoint: after sources/sha256/e5a1...eb41 is durable, before the envelope write

durableEffects: no acknowledged dangling reference ever exists
at worst unreferenced immutable bytes (never a reference acked before its bytes are durable)
observations: the orphan blob is not authoritative and not referenced; M2 has no GC, so it is retained
blob publication is idempotent: an existing file with the expected digest is never rewritten

notes: Pins the publish ordering: durable bytes first, envelope commit last, ack after the commit.
